name: ranus
description: RANUS — Autonomous Dollar & Asset Intelligence Agent (MCP server + Amazon Bedrock agent + Alexa+-style web client)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n mcp,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w mcp-server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n mcp,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w mcp-server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w web
